spanish: Y utensilio de barro que se cocinare en él será quebrado; y si en utensilio de bronce se cocinare, y será frotado y lavado en las aguas.

findings.issue: «que» makes the masculine vessel the thing cooked; תְּבֻשַּׁל is pual 3fs (a feminine item is cooked) and בּוֹ only places that cooking in the vessel.
One unstated subject is cooked and then rubbed and washed; בֻּשָּׁלָה is 3fs while וּמֹרַק and וְשֻׁטַּף are 3ms, so the vessel is scoured and rinsed.
findings.spanishSpan: se cocinare, y será frotado y lavado

findings.issue: Pual imperfect and pual perfect are both «se cocinare»; the aspect contrast is smoothed.
Pual of מָרַק is scour or polish; «frotado» only states rubbing.

notes: Breaking the earthen vessel, bronze as material, and rinsing in the waters match the tokens.
